investigation_notes.Description: A successful Office 365 login for laura.tamm@client.ee was observed from Saint Petersburg, Russia using IP 176.120.22.47, which is associated with a data-center/hosting provider and carries an abuse score of 100/100. Prior successful logins earlier the same day originated from Tallinn, Estonia, and there is no record of prior Russian access for this user, creating a clear geographic anomaly. Although MFA was used and the user agent is consistent with Azure AD authentication, the combination of a high-risk infrastructure IP, the unexpected country change, and lack of historical confirmation supports elevating this as a high-risk event.
